settings.heading: What payment methods can I use?
settings.content: We offer 35 different payment methods including major providers like Mastercard, Visa, PayPal, American Express and Diners as well as many different local payment methods including Klarna, iDEAL, AliPay, Sofort, giropay, and many more.

settings.heading: Can I purchase items with another currency?
settings.content: Yes, you may select a currency based on your personal preference. When you select the currency on the upper right of the website,all prices on the online store and checkout are automatically converted to that currency.

settings.heading: Can I make changes to my order after it’s been placed?
settings.content: We do everything we can to fulfill orders quickly and unfortunately cannot make updates after an order has been placed. These changes include removing or adding products and/or changing the delivery address. If a mistake has been made with your order information, it’s quickest to create a new order with the correct information and then let our Customer Service know at order@moodytiger.com .

settings.heading: Do you offer e-gift cards for international customers?
settings.content: Yes,you can purchase e-gift cards online.

settings.heading: How Do I Set Up A Subscription Order?
settings.content: We will deliver products to you as soon as reasonably possible. Orders are usually dispatched between 1-3 days from the date of the order being placed. Please contact us our customer service team at order@moodytiger.com if your delivery has not been received within the dates described.

settings.heading: How To Return My Items?
settings.content: At moodytiger, if you're not happy with your purchase for any reason, please Click this link to request submit the return request, and we will offer you solutions according to your case.

settings.heading: Will you ship to a P.O box address?
settings.content: At this time, we are unable to ship to P.O. box addresses.

settings.heading: Can all items be shipped in one package?
settings.content: If your order includes both shoes and clothing, or if the package is too large, items may be shipped in separate packages.

settings.heading: Package not received
settings.content: We highly recommend that you reach out to your local logistic company directly to verify the situation and initiate a proof of claim process. Once you provide the necessary documentation for us, we will be able to process a further solution.
